title: Koppa Maichiru Sono Koro ni
titleNative: 木っ端舞い散る その頃に
synopsis: Kei Maebara gets a job!! The bizarre and eerie world of public service, depicted by Ryukishi07, from Higurashi When They Cry . In the 13th year of the Heisei era, in the Tokyo Metropolitan Area, Coastal Region... Due to the prolonged economic recession, the police force has weakened, and the growing number of disillusioned youth turning to semi-criminal lifestyles has led to a drastic decline in public safety... Amidst all this, Kei Maebara begins working at the district office. Can he become a respectable public servant? (Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Meaheim
synopsis: Rotten fruit returns to the branch, and gold drips down like water, A land where events beyond reason occur, a land known as “Meichi” (The Underworld) that easily claims the lives of those who dare to enter. The scholar "Ren" arrives in this godforsaken land to save his sick younger brother. Together with the guide "Tobia", "Ren" embarks on a perilous journey to obtain the “panacea,” an ancient relic of “Meichi.” A genuine dark fantasy brought to you by "Tsurubuchi Kenji", creator of “Touge Oni,” and "Konata", a rising star of the Spanish comic world. (Source: Comic Days, translated)

title: I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class
titleRomaji: Class de 2-banme ni Kawaii Onnanoko to Tomodachi ni Natta
titleEnglish: I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class
titleNative: クラスで２番目に可愛い女の子と友だちになった
synonyms: I Became Friends with the Second Cutest Girl in My Class
我和班上第二可愛的女生成為朋友
synopsis: Maki Maehara is always on his own at school. He has no friends or hobbies others share, and he doesn't expect the upcoming academic year to be any different, even surrounded by new faces. And six months later, it seems like he was right-until he runs into his popular classmate Umi Asanagi at a video store! Always at the center of attention and called the "second prettiest in class" by the boys, Asanagi's from a totally different world. But it turns out the two have more overlapping interests than just the B-grade movies they came to check out...and Asanagi asks Maehara to be her friend! (Source: Yen Press)

title: Ginga Tokkyuu Milky☆Subway
titleNative: 銀河特急 ミルキー☆サブウェイ
synopsis: Chiharu the cyborg and Makina the cyborg are arrested for violating the Galactic Road Traffic Act. At the same time, the police also arrest two other eccentric duos: Akane and Kanata the cyborgs, and Kurt and Max the cyborgs. Police officer Ryoko gathers them all together and assigns them a volunteer task: cleaning the interplanetary train known as the "Milky☆Subway." It was supposed to be a simple mission, but before long, they find themselves embroiled in a major incident. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)
